description: The file defines Express.js route handlers for managing quizzes, including listing, retrieving, creating, updating, deleting quizzes, and starting quiz attempts. It also contains Swagger API documentation comments for these endpoints.

methods.name: router.get
methods.description: Handler for GET /quizzes, listing quizzes with optional publishedOnly filter.

methods.name: router.get
methods.description: Handler for GET /quizzes/:quizId, retrieving detailed info of a specific quiz.

methods.name: router.post
methods.description: Handler for POST /quizzes, creating a new quiz. Requires authentication and admin rights.

methods.name: router.patch
methods.description: Handler for PATCH /quizzes/:quizId, updating an existing quiz. Requires authentication and admin rights.

methods.name: router.delete
methods.description: Handler for DELETE /quizzes/:quizId, deleting a quiz. Requires authentication and admin rights.

methods.name: router.post
methods.description: Handler for POST /quizzes/:quizId/start, initiating an attempt for a quiz. Requires user authentication.
